title: Molecular Insights into the Interaction of Tryptophan Metabolites with the Human Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor in Silico: Tryptophan as Antagonist and no Direct Involvement of Kynurenine.
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接研究色氨酸代谢物与人芳香烃受体（AhR）的相互作用，虽涉及蛋白-配体对接，但对象为小分子-蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且未涉及TF-DNA结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: A direct link between the tryptophan (Trp) metabolite kynurenine (Kyn) and the aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR) is not supported by metabolic considerations and by studies demonstrating the failure of Kyn concentrations of up to 100 muM to activate the receptor in cell culture systems using the proxy system of cytochrome P-450-dependent metabolism. The Kyn metabolite kynurenic acid (KA) activates the AhR and may mediate the Kyn link. Recent studies demonstrated down regulation and antagonism of activation of the AhR by Trp. We have addressed the link between Kyn and the AhR by looking at their direct molecular interaction in silico. METHODS: Molecular docking of Kyn, KA, Trp and a range of Trp metabolites to the crystal structure of the human AhR was performed under appropriate docking conditions. RESULTS: Trp and 30 of its metabolites docked to the AhR to various degrees, whereas Kyn and 3-hydroxykynurenine did not. The strongest docking was observed with the Trp metabolite and photooxidation product 6-Formylindolo[3,2-b]carbazole (FICZ), cinnabarinic acid, 5-hydroxytryptophan, N-acetyl serotonin and indol-3-yllactic acid. Strong docking was also observed with other 5-hydroxyindoles. CONCLUSIONS: We propose that the Kyn-AhR link is mediated by KA. The strong docking of Trp and its recently reported down regulation of the receptor suggest that Trp is an AhR antagonist and may thus play important roles in body homeostasis beyond known properties or simply being the precursor of biologically active metabolites. Differences in AhR activation reported in the literature are discussed.
abstract_zh: 背景：色氨酸（Trp）代谢产物犬尿氨酸（Kyn）与芳香烃受体（AhR）之间的直接关联，在代谢学考量及研究表明高达100 μM的Kyn浓度在细胞培养系统中无法激活该受体（以细胞色素P-450依赖性代谢作为代理系统）的基础上，未得到支持。Kyn的代谢产物犬尿喹啉酸（KA）可激活AhR，并可能介导Kyn的关联作用。近期研究显示，Trp对AhR的激活具有下调和拮抗作用。我们通过计算机模拟研究Kyn与AhR之间的直接分子相互作用，以探讨其关联。方法：在适当的对接条件下，将Kyn、KA、Trp及一系列Trp代谢产物与人AhR晶体结构进行分子对接 (molecular docking)。结果：Trp及其30种代谢产物以不同程度对接至AhR，而Kyn和3-羟基犬尿氨酸未对接成功。最强的对接见于Trp代谢产物及光氧化产物6-甲酰基吲哚并[3,2-b]咔唑（FICZ）、肉桂酸、5-羟基色氨酸、N-乙酰血清素和吲哚-3-乳酸。其他5-羟基吲哚类化合物也表现出强对接。结论：我们提出Kyn-AhR关联由KA介导。Trp的强对接及其近期报道的受体下调作用表明，Trp是AhR的拮抗剂，因此可能在机体稳态中发挥重要作用，超越其已知特性或仅作为生物活性代谢产物的前体。本文还讨论了文献中报道的AhR激活差异。
